name: Domain of Blessing: Flower Feast II
entranceName: Thorny Crown of the Mountain Wind
description:
A floral realm hidden amidst the mountains, now seldom visited due to its remote location.
If you can defeat the scoundrels that dwell in this place, you may obtain precious artifacts.
disorder: When your active character's Normal or Charged Attack hits an opponent, the DMG dealt by their Charged Attack and Elemental Skill increases by 15% for 5s. Max 5 stacks. Each stack's duration is counted independently. This effect will be canceled when the character leaves the field.
